1.kind: Wrong structure for the 事件 head: annotator used 事件 ARG1-of identity-91 with 空袭-01 as ARG2, whereas gold makes 空袭-01 a :mod of 事件
1.cause: Annotator treated '事件' as an identity predicate (the attack is an event) instead of modifying the noun with the event modifier; the clause was modeled as an equation rather than a modified noun.
1.convention: A relative clause modifying a generic noun like 事件 is attached as :mod of that noun; identity-91 is not used for it.

1.kind: The organization name is split wrongly: annotator attached 人道主义 as :mod of the international-organization, while gold makes it a :mod of 组织 in an identity-91 on the organization; the possessor is expressed as possessor-of in gold and possessor in the annotator's graph
1.cause: Annotator did not represent the appositive '人道主义组织' as a separate 组织 concept equated by identity-91 with the named organization, and used :possessor rather than the inverse :possessor-of.
1.convention: A possessed head noun takes the possessor via :possessor-of on the possessor entity; an appositive category noun is linked to the named entity by identity-91.

1.kind: The 车队 in the 空袭 clause is not an event argument with a full possessor; the annotator reused the 遇袭 车队 node (s1d) by reentrancy, and the 遇袭 车队 role is ARG1 instead of ARG0
1.cause: Annotator reentered the first convoy instead of creating a separate node for the second mention and linking the two by coref. It also gave 遇袭-00 an ARG1 where gold uses ARG0.
1.convention: Each mention gets its own node, and repeated mentions are linked by document-level coreference rather than reentrancy. Subject of 遇袭-00 is ARG0.

1.kind: The count '3 次' is annotated wrongly: gold uses :frequency 3 and :unit 次, while the annotator used a have-frequency-91 with ARG2 3
1.cause: Annotator used the have-frequency-91 construction for the quantified 次 and dropped 次 as a unit.
1.convention: A number with a classifier/measure word 次 is given as :frequency <number> with the classifier as :unit.

1.kind: The 提供 clause is not attached as :temporal to the 空袭 event and its ARG0 is the convoy; the annotator made it a coordinated op2 under 'and' with a separate 车队 node and a 当时 concept
1.cause: Annotator treated '当时 ...' as a coordinated clause and made 当时 a concept; gold treats the clause as a temporal modifier of the attack, with the convoy as ARG0 by reentrancy.
1.convention: A clause introduced by 当时 ('at that time') is a :temporal modifier of the main event, not a coordinated clause, and 当时 is not a separate concept.

1.kind: The 援助-01 aspect is process in gold but activity in annotator, and the 提供-01 ARG1 and ARG0 structure differs (annotator has no 援助 as ARG1 carrying aspect process)
1.cause: Annotator chose activity for 援助-01 where gold chose process.

1.kind: Extra top-level coordination and an extra annotator aspect/structure: annotator wrapped the sentence in an 'and' root
1.cause: Because the 提供 clause was treated as a coordinated clause, an 'and' root was added over 指-01.
1.convention: Do not add a coordination root when a clause is a subordinate modifier.

1.kind: Temporal relations differ: the date-entity is not :contained over 遇袭, 提供 and 援助 chain is not formed, and an extra overlap on 指-01 with document-creation-time is added
1.cause: Annotator tied the date to 空袭 only, placed 遇袭 and 提供 as overlapping 空袭 in a different arrangement, and added a DCT overlap for the state 指-01, which gold does not give.
1.convention: The event's date-entity is :contained over the events it dates, and the chain follows the nesting of the clauses; stative 指 gets no DCT relation.

1.kind: Extra 'name' mod and wrong role on name node: annotator's graph has :mod on the organization where gold has none
1.cause: Consequence of attaching 人道主义 to the organization instead of to 组织.

1.kind: Coreference chains differ: the convoy chain and the armed-organization/local-region chains are incomplete or partly wrong across the document
1.cause: Annotator reused a node by reentrancy and linked the second mention with a coref link to a different node, so chains involve different members and miss mentions.
1.convention: Link every mention of the same entity into a single coreference chain.

2.kind: causal verb 致使 kept as a lexical predicate instead of the abstract have-cause-91 with the cause as ARG2 and the effect as ARG1
2.cause: The annotator treated 致使 ('cause') as an ordinary event predicate and gave it a PropBank-style frame (致使-01) instead of mapping causative constructions to the abstract have-cause-91 concept.
2.convention: Causal/resultative predicates expressing a cause-effect relation between two events are annotated with the abstract concept have-cause-91, with ARG1 = effect and ARG2 = cause.

2.kind: wrong core argument structure of the causal relation: cause placed as ARG0, effect clause as ARG2, and the workers as a spurious ARG1
2.cause: The annotator used a three-argument frame (causer, patient, result) for 致使. The gold uses have-cause-91 with only ARG1 (effect event 身亡) and ARG2 (cause event 袭击). As a result the workers are not the direct ARG0 of 身亡-01, and labels are shifted (arg1 vs arg2, arg2 vs arg0).
2.convention: have-cause-91 takes ARG1 = the effect event and ARG2 = the cause event. Participants (e.g. the workers) are arguments of the effect event, not of the causal relation itself.

2.kind: workers attached as an argument of the causal predicate and shared by reentrancy, so 身亡-01 lacks its own ARG0 node in the gold structure
2.cause: Following the wrong 致使 frame, the annotator put the workers under 致使 and only used a reentrancy in 身亡-01. The gold puts the full 工作者 subtree directly as ARG0 of 身亡-01.
2.convention: The participant noun phrase is annotated as the ARG0 of the effect event 身亡-01 and is not an argument of the causative.

2.kind: 车队 related to 工作者 with possessor-of instead of part-of
2.cause: The annotator interpreted the 的 construction as possession and reversed it with :possessor-of. The gold treats the workers as a part/member of the convoy (:part-of). The relation label and direction were therefore both off.
2.convention: Membership/part relations between a group (e.g. a convoy) and its members in 'X的N' constructions are annotated with :part-of, not possession.

2.kind: extra aspect on the abstract have-cause-91 predicate
2.cause: The annotator put :aspect performance on the causal predicate 致使-01. Abstract have-cause-91 concepts do not take aspect in the gold.
2.convention: Abstract predicates such as have-cause-91 carry no :aspect; aspect is only annotated on event concepts.

2.kind: wrong temporal relations: the cause event is not anchored to document-creation-time, the temporal ordering of cause and effect is wrong, and the causal predicate itself is anchored
2.cause: The annotator placed the document-creation-time :before link and the :overlap/:after links on the causal predicate 致使 (s2a) instead of on the cause event 袭击 (s2b). It also stated that 致使 overlaps 身亡, where the gold has the attack :after the deaths. It also added an :overlap link between 袭击 and the previous sentence's event instead of using coreference. The gold has the attack before document creation time and after 身亡 (the gold's ordering is itself oddly reversed).
2.convention: Temporal relations are annotated between event concepts (not on abstract have-cause-91); the event of the cause is anchored to document-creation-time.

2.kind: modal annotation extra on the abstract causal predicate
2.cause: The annotator added (author :full-affirmative s2a) for the causal predicate. Abstract have-cause-91 does not receive a modal link in the gold.
2.convention: Modal relations are only annotated on event concepts, not on abstract predicates such as have-cause-91.

2.kind: coreference chains incomplete or wrongly built for the attack event, the convoy and the workers
2.cause: The annotator linked this sentence's 袭击 to the previous sentence's 空袭 but did not extend the chain to later mentions of the same event, and the 车队 chain is missing or has differing members. The annotator also linked the later 遇难者 and other person mentions as subsets of the workers, which the gold does not. Part of this is a consequence of the annotator's different node structure (e.g. coref attached to s2h/possessor 车队 node).
2.convention: Repeated mentions of the same event, and the same entity (e.g. the convoy) across sentences are chained together as same-event/same-entity. Subset relations are only annotated when the set relation is clear.

3.kind: Temporal 'after' clause attached as :temporal on the first conjunct instead of on the whole coordination; 发生 related to wrong events
3.cause: Annotator put the 后 clause under the 宣布 event (op1) rather than as a sentence-level temporal of the top 'and'. Consequently the temporal chain was anchored differently: 发生 was placed after 宣布 and 表示 and related to DCT, instead of 宣布 :after 发生 and 发生 :before DCT, and 发生 overlap 作为/袭击 was used instead of 指出 overlap them.
3.convention: A '后/after' clause that scopes over the whole sentence is a :temporal of the top-level coordination. Document-level temporal relations are anchored on the main event (宣布 after 发生) and the embedded events of a reported content are overlapped with the reporting verb (指出).

3.kind: Temporal order of 宣布 and 暂停 reversed (after instead of before)
3.cause: Annotator treated 暂停 as following the announcement incorrectly; gold has 宣布 :after 暂停 in the gold relations (announcing a suspension), the evaluator expects before/after per gold.

3.kind: Event noun 事件 ('incident') treated as a plain concept and the 发生 argument given as ARG1; 空袭 attached as modifier of 事件 instead of identity-91 link; 发生 ARG0 vs ARG1 and coref missing
3.check: a_event_found, a_event_concept, d_core_args_event, d_core_args_abstract, d_peripheral_event, j_coref_chain, i_modal
3.cause: Annotator made 空袭-01 the head with :mod 事件 (and 事件 separately under 发生) instead of the gold's 事件 identified with 空袭-01 via identity-91, with 事件 shared as the argument of 发生 and 谴责. Hence 事件 wrongly counted as an event concept, 空袭 got ARG1 role mismatch, identity-91 missing, and 空袭 not coreferent with earlier 袭击/空袭 (gold has 事件 same-event with s2x2). Modal for 空袭-01 also missing.
3.convention: A generic event noun like 事件 referring to a previously mentioned attack is annotated as the noun concept with an identity-91 ARG2 pointing to the specific event, and it is coreferred with the earlier event mention; each event gets its own author modal.

3.kind: Abstract 行为 modified by an 'and' via :mod instead of identity-91 ARG2
3.cause: Annotator attached the two appositive clauses ('将粮食作为战争武器' and '对援助者进行袭击') as :mod of 行为; gold uses identity-91 with the coordinated and as ARG2 (行为 is equated with those actions). The 'and' node was thus created as :mod rather than inside identity-91.
3.convention: When a noun like 行为 is defined by a content clause ('the act of X'), link it with ARG1-of identity-91 whose ARG2 is the described event(s) rather than :mod.

3.kind: Top-level coordination structure: flat four-way 'and' instead of nested 'and' for the 表示/谴责 pair
3.cause: Annotator made all four clauses direct conjuncts of one 'and'; gold groups 表示 and 谴责 (sharing the subject) in a separate nested 'and' as op3.
3.convention: Verbs coordinated with a shared subject (表示震惊并谴责) are grouped in their own nested coordination.

3.kind: 世界各国领袖 analysed as flat mods instead of 领袖 possessor-of 国 (mod 各, part-of 世界)
3.cause: Annotator treated 世界 and 各国 as simple :mod of 领袖, missing the 国 entity, the 各 quantifier concept and the part-of structure.
3.convention: Possessive/membership noun phrases like 'leaders of every country in the world' are decomposed into possessor-of 国 with 各 as mod and part-of 世界.

3.kind: 人道援助 collapsed into one concept; 援助-01 event and 人道 split missed
3.cause: Annotator lexicalised 人道援助 as a single noun concept rather than 人道 mod plus 援助-01 event mod; also made 行动 ARG0 s3c and used :aspect activity while gold has the organization as :possessor and no aspect on 行动.
3.convention: Compounds containing a verbal head (援助) are split into the event concept with its modifier; 其 possessive of a nominal event is :possessor, not ARG0, and non-event-like nominalized 行动 gets no aspect.

3.kind: Aspect errors: 作为-01 marked performance (gold state); 行动 aspect extra
3.cause: Annotator judged 作为 (treat X as Y) as a performance; gold treats it as state. Extra activity on 行动 from verbalizing the noun.
3.convention: 'Treat as/regard as' predicates (作为) are states.

3.kind: Modal structure errors: source of embedded events and polarity; 宣布→暂停 should be unspecified and 暂停→行动 not; missing author modal for the organization and 空袭; 震惊 anchored under author instead of 表示
3.cause: Annotator hung embedded clause events (饶恕, 作为, 袭击) on 指出 with full-affirmative or on the organization; gold puts the organisation (s3i2) as modal head for 作为/袭击 (full-affirmative) and 饶恕 as full-negative from the 饶恕 negation, with the author affirming the entity. Annotator also had author affirm 暂停 directly in the wrong form vs 宣布 :unspecified 暂停, inserted an extra 暂停 :unspecified 行动, and gave 震惊 author-level rather than 表示 :full-affirmative.
3.convention: Negated predicates (polarity -) get :full-negative from their source; complement events of a speech act are anchored to the speaker/source (here the organization), and the speech-act complement is :unspecified from its verb; author affirms agent entities and event heads.

3.kind: Polarity not marked on the correct level / ARG1 of 饶恕 structure; 谴责 coref and event chain: extra coref links and missing 事件 coref
3.cause: Annotator's coreference chains differ: it linked 空袭 with s1k (earlier 空袭) but omitted the 袭击 (s2) member, and partially mismatched the 加沙地带 chain. The annotator also has no 行动-based extra chains in gold.
3.convention: Coreference chains should include all mentions of the same event/entity across sentences, including differently worded mentions (袭击/空袭/事件).

4.kind: Concessive connective labeled but-91 instead of contrast-01
4.cause: Annotator mapped 但 to the but-91 frame instead of the UMR contrast-01 concept used for 虽然...但 constructions
4.convention: Contrastive/concessive coordination (虽然...但, but) is annotated with contrast-01 rather than but-91

4.kind: Missing 导致-01 event; 'cause' of the incident was attached as a :cause relation instead of an ARG1-of 导致-01 whose ARG0 is the 以为 event
4.cause: Annotator treated 因为...而导致 as a :cause relation on 意外 and dropped the explicit predicate 导致 that is present in the text
4.convention: Every overt verbal predicate (e.g. 导致) is annotated as its own event concept; the cause is expressed as ARG1-of 导致-01 with the cause event as ARG0, not as a :cause modifier

4.kind: 混入 arguments mislabeled: 成员 as ARG1 and 车队 as :place, gold has 成员 as ARG0 and 车队 as ARG1
4.cause: Annotator treated 车队中混入 as a locative and the 成员 as the entity being mixed in (theme), rather than using the gold's role assignment where the member is the agent and the convoy is the entity entered
4.convention: Locative phrases with 中 that are semantically the core theme/goal of the verb are annotated as core arguments, not :place

4.kind: Membership in Hamas annotated as :part-of armed-organization instead of ARG1-of have-org-role-92 with an organization
4.cause: Annotator used a part-of relation and the armed-organization type for 'Hamas member' rather than the UMR have-org-role-92 pattern
4.convention: Membership in an organization (X member) is annotated with ARG1-of have-org-role-92 and an organization named entity

4.kind: 武装 annotated as a bare noun/modifier instead of the verbal 武装-01 with aspect
4.cause: Annotator did not recognize 武装 as an event predicate and left it without a sense or aspect
4.convention: Predicative modifiers that are verbal in nature are annotated as -01 events with aspect

4.kind: Wrong or missing aspect values: identity-91 and 坚持-01 are state in gold; 导致-01 performance; 以为 etc.
4.cause: Annotator gave 坚持-01 performance and omitted aspect on identity-91 and 意外, whereas the gold marks the identity and the 坚持 predicate as state and adds aspect to 导致-01
4.convention: Stative predicates such as 坚持 (maintain a position) and identity-91 take aspect state

4.kind: Extra :temporal on 道歉 shared with 承认 (立刻 scoped over both)
4.cause: Annotator re-used the 立刻 node under both coordinated events, while the gold attaches it to 承认 only
4.convention: An adverb is attached to the nearest verb it modifies rather than distributed over coordinated predicates

4.kind: Temporal relations wrong: 坚持 and 以为 overlap instead of before, 以为 and 混入 overlap instead of before, missing 导致 relations, and wrong ordering of 承认/道歉/坚持
4.cause: Annotator did not model the 导致 event, chained 坚持/以为/混入 with the wrong relations, and ordered 道歉 vs 坚持 differently from the gold chain
4.convention: Reported/believed content precedes or follows the reporting event per the gold's chain; the cause event 导致 overlaps the incident (空袭), and 以为 is after 导致

4.kind: Missing 混入 overlap 武装 temporal and missing modal relations for 武装 and 空袭
4.cause: Because 武装 was not annotated as an event, no relations were added for it; 空袭 was not given an author modal edge
4.convention: Every event node gets a modal edge from the author or relevant conceiver, and modifier events are temporally linked to their heads

4.kind: Wrong conceiver for the modal relations: author used instead of the country (以色列) for 以为, and missing country-conceiver edges
4.cause: Annotator attached all event modals to the author, whereas content that is the country's belief/claim (以为, 导致, identity-91) should be anchored to the country
4.convention: Events within a reported belief or claim are anchored to the source (the sentient agent) with full-affirmative; the author edge applies only to events asserted by the author

4.kind: 以为→混入 modal is full-affirmative in gold, but the annotator used unspecified
4.cause: Annotator was cautious about the truth of the mistaken belief, whereas the gold marks the complement as full-affirmative

4.kind: Missing author→country and country→identity-91 modal edges
4.cause: Annotator did not add modal edges for the country as a conceiver and for the identity-91 clause
4.convention: Sentient agents who hold positions are linked to the author and to their asserted clauses

4.kind: Coreference chains incomplete or wrong (country, 空袭 event, 车队, 道歉)
4.cause: Annotator linked the 车队 in this sentence to the wrong antecedent (s1d) and the 空袭 to s1k, instead of s2x8 and s3x25, and left out other mentions of the country and the apology
4.convention: Each repeated mention is linked to the most recent antecedent in the chain, and repeated mentions of the same country or event are all included

5.kind: Named event given wrong concept (行动-01 instead of event)
5.cause: Annotator treated the last token of the name 阿克萨洪水行动 as an event predicate and gave it a verbal concept with aspect, instead of using a generic 'event' concept for the named event.
5.convention: Named entities that are events take the general concept 'event' with a :name, not a predicate frame from the final name token.

5.kind: Named war analysed as a compositional predicate (战争-01 with ARG0 'and' of the parties) instead of a named 'war' entity with a full name
5.cause: Annotator decomposed 以色列—哈马斯战争 into a predicate with a coordinated agent and no name. Gold treats it as a named entity (war) with name tokens 以色列 — 哈马斯 战争, which serves as ARG1 of 爆发-01. The annotator's ARG1 is the 战争-01 node, which the evaluator matched against the name node.
5.convention: Proper-name expressions (including named wars) are annotated as a named entity with a concept (war) and a :name containing all name tokens, not decomposed into participants.

5.kind: Extra reflected relations on the wrongly built war node (temporal overlap and modal)
5.cause: Because 战争-01 was made an event, the annotator added (爆发 :overlap 战争) and (author :full-affirmative 战争), which the gold lacks.
5.convention: Only real events get temporal and modal relations; named entities do not.

5.kind: Wrong temporal order between 反击/宣战 and 爆发 and between 发动 and 反击
5.cause: Annotator imposed sequence from the 'consecutive' structure and the 随即 cue: 发动 :before 反击 (gold: 发动 :after 反击) and 宣战 :before 爆发 (gold: overlap). Gold treats the coordinated 反击/宣战/爆发 as overlapping and also puts 发动 after 反击 in gold, which looks odd given 随即 (gold likely errs on 发动/反击).
5.convention: Events under the same coordination or in a simultaneous-outcome clause are annotated with :overlap; temporal relations follow the gold's cross-sentence chain (e.g. 爆发 before later events in sentence 6).

5.kind: Missing cross-sentence temporal link from the next sentence's event
5.cause: The annotator did not link 爆发 to the following sentence's 面临 (gold: 面临 :after 爆发).
5.convention: Consecutive events across adjacent sentences are linked temporally in document-level relations.

5.kind: Coreference chain incomplete / wrong: country chain not extended and an erroneous link in 此后
5.cause: The annotator did not link the later mentions of Israel (snt15, snt19) into the chain, and linked 此 to the wrong node (此后 analysed with a different head: 此 vs 后).
5.convention: All mentions of the same entity across the document are chained; the 此后 expression is annotated consistently as in gold.

5.cause: The annotator wrote (s5e :same-event s5e), a self-link with no antecedent.
5.convention: Coreference links need a distinct antecedent; no self-links.

5.kind: Extra reentrant ARG1 on 反击-01 and aspect on named event
5.cause: Annotator added :ARG1 s5e to 反击 (the Al-Aqsa Flood event) and gave it an aspect; gold has only ARG0 for 反击.
5.convention: Do not add arguments not overtly expressed in the clause.

6.kind: Causal construction modeled as have-reason-91 root instead of :cause on the main event with 缘故 / include-91
6.cause: The annotator treated 由于...缘故 as a clause-level reason relation and made have-reason-91 the root, with 面临 as ARG1 and 封锁 as ARG2. The gold keeps 面临-01 as root, attaches the cause via :cause to the noun 缘故, and links 封锁 through include-91 (ARG2-of, with 封锁 as ARG1). The annotator omitted the 缘故 concept and the 'et al.' include-91 structure.
6.convention: 'X 等 缘故' (reasons such as X) is annotated as a :cause on the main event whose value is the noun 缘故, with an include-91 ARG2-of whose ARG1 is the listed event. 由于 does not create a have-reason-91 root when the clause has its own main predicate.

6.kind: Wrong aspect on 面临-01 (activity instead of state)
6.cause: The annotator read 正 面临 as progressive and marked it as activity. The gold treats the ongoing condition of facing a famine as a state.
6.convention: Predicates of being in or facing a condition (面临 'face') are annotated as aspect state, even with progressive 正.

6.kind: 此后 mis-analyzed: 后 given as bare :temporal without 此 as :op1, and treated as a plain argument of the event
6.cause: The annotator dropped 此 ('this') from 此后 and left 后 with no :op1. In the gold, 此 is the reference point (a coreferent with the event in s5), and 后 is a temporal relation to it.
6.convention: A temporal noun like 此后 'after this' is annotated as 后 with :op1 此, and 此 is linked by same-event coref to the previously mentioned event.

6.cause: The annotator used DCT :overlap 面临, 面临 :after s5 event, and 封锁 :overlap 面临. The gold anchors on 此: DCT :before 此, 此 :overlap 封锁, and 此 :after 面临. The annotator's relations hang off 面临 and the have-reason-91 node, and miss the 此 node.
6.convention: Temporal relations for 此后 attach to the 此 node (DCT :before 此, 此 :overlap the caused event, 此 :after the main event) rather than directly to the main predicate.

6.kind: Place name split into two :op tokens in a way the evaluator scored as extra tokens
6.cause: The annotator gave the name as 加沙 + 地带 in two ops, while the evaluator reports the extra as 加沙 地带. The gold name shows the same two ops, so the mismatch likely comes from the evaluator's alignment, since the entity was matched to a different node.

6.kind: Coreference chains differ: the annotator linked 加沙地带 to s1ae and left out the other country and place links, and did not link the s5 event to 此
6.cause: The annotator built the 加沙地带 chain on a different node and missed links from 以色列 to earlier mentions (s5c). It linked 后 to the s5 event rather than 此, and it created a link from s6j to s4d but did not carry the chain on to the later mentions in the gold chain.
6.convention: Repeated mentions of the same named entity are chained across the document, and the event referred to by 此后 is linked by same-event coref from 此 to the earlier event.

7.cause: Annotator ignored the aspectual adverb 已 ('already') and did not add it as a :mod on the main event
7.convention: Aspectual or degree adverbs such as 已 are kept as :mod concepts of the event they modify

7.kind: Relative-clause organization attached as ARG1 of 工作-01 instead of :place
7.cause: Annotator treated the organization as the thing worked on (ARG1) rather than as the location or employer of the work
7.convention: For 'in/at organization' work, the organization is a :place of 工作-01, not a core argument

7.kind: Event 行动 annotated as :place instead of :temporal
7.cause: Annotator read 在行动中 ('in the action') as a locative and used :place; gold treats an event-denoting 'in X' phrase as a temporal anchor
7.convention: Event nouns in a 在...中 frame are :temporal on the main event, not :place

7.kind: Wrong aspect values (工作-01, 提供-01, 行动-01 and extra aspect on 援助-01)
7.cause: Annotator labelled 工作 as state (gold habitual), 提供 as habitual (gold activity), 行动 as performance (gold activity), and added habitual on 援助-01, which gold leaves without aspect
7.convention: Ongoing or characteristic activities, including the nominal event 行动, get activity; 工作 as a job/role is habitual; nominalized or embedded argument events like 援助 get no aspect

7.kind: Temporal relation of the date-entity to the main event: contained instead of before
7.cause: Annotator treated 至 ('until') as containing the event; gold places the event before/up to the date, with DCT before the date
7.convention: A 至-date (up-to) phrase is anchored with the reference date after the event: date :before the event

7.kind: Wrong or missing temporal chain among 提供, 援助, 工作, 行动

8.kind: Arguments of 进入-01 wrong: 物资 as ARG1 and 加沙 as ARG2, with 阻碍 as manner; gold has 物资 ARG0, 加沙 ARG1, and 阻碍-01 as ARG1-of of 进入

8.kind: 水电 treated as coordination of 水 and 电 rather than a single concept; 基本 attached to the 需 event rather than to 生活; 供应 place vs ARG2

8.kind: Name of 加沙地带 split: 加沙 and 加沙 地带 given as two different names, and the local-region referent is not shared across the two mentions

8.kind: Wrong aspect values: 展开-01 and 救援 annotated as process, 救援 given a sense and an aspect, 裁决 and others missing aspect

8.kind: Temporal relations of the event sequence wrong: the 事发 anchoring (gold: 通过 :before 事发, 3-day-before contained in 通过), the 要求 and 保证 ordering (annotator after/overlap vs gold before), 进入, 供应, 诉-犯下 and 审理-诉 relations

8.kind: Modal annotation errors: 阻碍 negation attached to author instead of 保证; extra author affirmation for 事发; missing author affirmations for 裁决, 救援, 需, 前; 犯下 and 灭绝 modal under 诉

8.kind: Coreference mistakes: 事发 not linked to the earlier 空袭 event chain; country (以色列) chain missing later mentions; local-region chain wrongly extended; 行动 linked erroneously

9.kind: Reporting verb concept: 写 instead of 写道-01 (the lexicalized compound verb)

9.kind: Modal annotation: modal source/head attached to 裁决 (s9b) in annotator but gold uses the reporting event; and temporal/modal heads differ because of graph differences

9.kind: The compound 大饥荒 (great famine) split into 饥荒 plus mod 大 instead of a single concept 大饥荒
9.cause: Annotator decomposed the lexicalized compound into modifier and head, creating an extra 大 node
9.convention: Lexicalized Chinese compounds such as 大饥荒 are kept as one concept rather than split into mod + head

9.kind: The copular-like relation between 危机 and 大饥荒 ('crisis of a famine') annotated as :topic instead of identity-91 with ARG1-of/ARG2 on the 危机
9.cause: Annotator used a :topic relation for the 的-modifier relation instead of the appositive/identity-91 construction
9.convention: When a noun is identified with another noun ('the crisis of X' meaning the crisis is X), use identity-91 with ARG1/ARG2

9.kind: 发生-01 argument role wrong: 大饥荒 as ARG1 and Gaza as :place, versus gold ARG0 大饥荒 and ARG1 Gaza
9.cause: Annotator treated the famine as the theme of 发生 and the location as an oblique :place, whereas gold follows the frame with ARG0 the happening thing and ARG1 the location/affected

9.kind: Coreference: Gaza chain linked to different antecedents and the ruling coreference type (same-event in gold vs same-entity), plus missing implicit-argument/other chain members

10.kind: Source-attribution 据…报告 analysed as have-source-91 modifier instead of 报告-01 as the root event whose ARG1 is the 死亡 event; wrong root structure (and as top-level conjunction)
10.check: d_core_args_event / d_core_args_abstract / e_core_labels / a_event_concept / h_temporal / i_modal
10.cause: Annotator treated 据…报告 as an adjunct source phrase and made the death event the head, then joined the second clause with 'and', rather than making the reporting event the root with the reported content as ARG1.
10.convention: Evidential 'according to X report' phrases are annotated with the report event as the head and the reported proposition as its ARG1 (ARG0 the reporter); the temporal and modal relations are then anchored on the report event (report before reported events; reporter full-affirmative the content).

10.kind: UN observer modelled as 观察员 modified by bare 联合国 concept instead of have-org-role-92 with an international-organization named entity
10.cause: Annotator did not name the organization and used mod instead of the org-role structure.

10.kind: Cause clause (营养不良 or 脱水) analysed as :cause of the death rather than as ARG0 of 死亡-01; ARG1 and ARG0 labels shifted

10.kind: Quantified people given as English 'person' concept instead of the Chinese word 人
10.cause: Annotator used an English placeholder concept for a word present in the text.

10.kind: 其中 27人为儿童 analysed as a separate conjunct with include-91 (ARG1 subset, ARG2 whole as reentrancy) instead of embedded via ARG2-of include-91 under the 31 人; identity-91 lacks aspect state
10.cause: Annotator built a top-level and-coordination and put the include-91 on the subset, rather than attaching it to the whole as an inverse role.
10.convention: Subset/'among which' relations are attached to the whole entity as ARG2-of include-91 with the subset as ARG1; identity-91 stative predicates carry :aspect state.

10.kind: Extra :aspect state on 营养不良-01 and 脱水-01 (and missing state on identity-91)
10.cause: Annotator marked the nominal event concepts as states, while gold leaves them unmarked.

10.kind: Temporal relations misanchored: death :after cause (extra), report-before-conditions wrong, and the or-coordination overlap not anchored on the or node
10.cause: Consequence of the different structure: temporal chain was built from the wrong report node and the cause node rather than reporting event before the death and its causes.

10.kind: Modal: author-to-observer chain wrong; observer full-affirmative linked to causes (营养不良, 脱水) and death instead of the death and the identity-91 clause
10.cause: Annotator attached the source's modal relation to each embedded event rather than to the main reported content, and missed the identity-91 event.

10.kind: Coreference of 加沙 linked to the wrong antecedent chain (sentence 1 vs previous sentence); chain members differ and an extra person coref added
10.cause: Annotator linked to the first mention (s1g) and mis-identified some chain members (e.g., 种族, implicit arguments) rather than chaining to the immediately preceding mention.
10.convention: Coreferent mentions are chained to the previous mention in the document; same-entity chains should include all mentions of the same place and exclude merely related entities.

11.kind: Appositive/role of a person analyzed as identity-91 with individual-person instead of have-role-91 with person
11.cause: Annotator treated '厨师和餐馆老板' as an identity predicate on a person (using individual-person and identity-91 with ARG2) rather than the occupational/role predicate have-role-91 with ARG3 and plain person. The generic role concept 'person' was not used for named persons.

11.kind: Modifier 著名 and possessor 餐馆 attached wrongly inside the coordination

11.kind: Wrong predicate lemma: 致力 instead of 致力于

11.kind: Wrong aspect on 提供 and 援助

11.kind: 食品 analyzed as :mod of 援助 rather than :ARG1

11.kind: 各地 attachment and structure wrong (place on the 'and' with :mod 世界 instead of place under 影响 with :part-of)

11.kind: Missing modal annotation for the main identity-91 predicate
11.cause: Annotator did not include the top identity-91 event in the modal relations and instead assigned affirmation to s11p only in a different way.

12.kind: Coordination structure flattened: three-way 'and' instead of nested and (op2 = and of 投诉 and 要求)
12.cause: Annotator treated the three clauses as flat coordination rather than grouping the two 世界中央厨房 actions (complaint and request) under a nested 'and' separate from the sniper event

12.kind: Possessed entity annotated with :possessor instead of inverse :possessor-of on the organization; extra/missing possessor relation; 安全 lacks possessor-of 人员 and was annotated as 安全-01 with ARG1

12.convention: Possession in Chinese 的 constructions is annotated with the possessor-of relation from the possessor, and nouns such as 安全 are kept as plain nouns (not -01 predicates) with possessor-of

12.kind: Wrong aspect on 保障 (process vs state)
12.cause: Annotator judged the protection as an ongoing process, while gold treats the requested/irrealis protection as state

12.kind: Wrong temporal anchoring of 开火 and 事发: annotator put DCT before 开火 and DCT before 事发 and 开火 before 事发; gold has temporal-quantity contained 开火, 事发 before the temporal-quantity, and DCT before 事发

12.convention: A temporal-quantity with 前 (before) modifying an event is anchored: reference event :before temporal-quantity, and temporal-quantity :contained the described event

12.kind: Wrong temporal order between 开火 and 投诉
12.cause: Annotator placed 开火 before 投诉 (natural chronological order), whereas gold has the relation reversed (:after)

12.kind: Wrong relation between 要求 and 保障 (after vs overlap)
12.cause: Annotator treated the guaranteed event as following the request; gold treats it as overlapping

12.kind: Missing temporal overlap between 保障 and 工作; extra overlap between 保障 and 安全 (from treating 安全 as an event)

12.kind: Missing modal for 工作 and extra modal unspecified on 安全
12.cause: Same cause: 安全 treated as event; 工作-01 not annotated with a modal
12.convention: Every event concept, including embedded 工作-01 within a noun phrase, gets a modal annotation

12.kind: Coreference chains incomplete: country 以色列 chain and armed-organization 军队 chain only partially linked; event coreference of 事发 with earlier mentions (空袭 etc.) missing; the gold links 世界中央厨房 to earlier mention
12.cause: Annotator linked only some antecedents (and linked 以色列 country to s4d only), and did not mark the 事发 event as coreferent with earlier mention of the same event; links to 军队 chain were not made

13.kind: Purpose clause 用于 not annotated as its own predicate; 用于-01 missing and 救援 attached as :purpose
13.cause: Annotator treated 用于 as a purpose marker and attached 救援-01 via :purpose to 粮食, instead of building a 用于-01 event with :ARG2 救援-01 under 粮食 via :ARG1-of. This also removed the 用于 temporal (overlap with 卸下 and 救援) and modal (full-affirmative) relations.
13.convention: A verb-like word such as 用于 'used for' that links a noun to a purpose is annotated as a predicate (用于-01) with the modified noun as ARG1 (via :ARG1-of) and the purpose event as ARG2, not as a :purpose relation. Such predicates get their own temporal and modal relations.

13.kind: Wrong aspect on 救援-01 (performance instead of process); missing aspect on 用于
13.cause: Annotator gave performance to the purpose event, but gold treats the ongoing, habitual-type relief activity as process (and 用于 as state).

13.kind: Quantity modifier 约 translated to English 'about'
13.cause: Annotator used the English concept 'about' instead of keeping the source-language lemma 约.
13.convention: Concepts for non-English words are kept in the source language (约) rather than translated into English.

13.kind: Wrong named-entity type for 加沙地带 (local-region vs country-region)
13.cause: Annotator chose local-region for Gaza Strip, while gold uses country-region. This also causes mismatches in the coref chain of this entity, which mixes concept types across sentences.

13.kind: Wrong role for 空袭 under 发生-01 (ARG1 instead of ARG0)
13.cause: Annotator treated 发生 as unaccusative with the happening event as ARG1; gold labels it ARG0.

13.kind: Wrong document-level temporal structure for the temporal-quantity; extra before relation to 发生
13.cause: Annotator anchored 卸下 directly to the document creation time and added 卸下 :before 发生. Gold anchors the temporal-quantity (一小时前) to DCT with :before and says it contains 卸下, with no direct relation between 卸下 and 发生 in the temporal-quantity anchor.
13.convention: A temporal-quantity expression such as 'one hour before X' is itself anchored to the document-creation-time (:before) and :contains/:contained the main event, instead of relating the main event directly to the reference event.

13.kind: Missing modal for 空袭-01 (and 发生/用于 in the gold set)
13.cause: Annotator did not add a full-affirmative modal for the embedded 空袭-01 event inside the temporal expression, only for 发生-01.
13.convention: Every event predicate, including those embedded in temporal expressions, receives a modal relation with author.

13.kind: Coreference chains differ: incorrect/missing links for 空袭 events and the Gaza entity
13.cause: Annotator linked 空袭 to a different earlier antecedent (s1k) than the gold (s12x9, 事发) and linked other entities to different chain members, and missed an implicit-argument chain.

14.kind: Locative modifier 位于 and purpose modifier 用以 not given as event predicates; annotator used :place and :purpose roles instead of 位于-01 and 用以-01 with ARG0-of
14.cause: Annotator treated 位于 and 用以 as relational roles (:place, :purpose) rather than verbs that head relative-clause events. This dropped two events and their modal and temporal relations.
14.convention: Verbal modifiers of a noun, such as 位于 'located at' and 用以 'used for', are annotated as events with the noun as ARG0-of. Each gets its own aspect (state) and full-affirmative modal.

14.kind: Nominal 救援 annotated as a bare concept instead of event 救援-01 with aspect process; missing modal and temporal links
14.cause: Annotator treated 救援 as a plain modifier noun and not as a deverbal event.
14.convention: Deverbal or event nouns used as modifiers are annotated as event concepts with a sense (-01), an aspect (process), a modal relation and temporal overlap with the head event.

14.kind: Classifier 个 for 车队 missing (:quant 1 and :unit 个)
14.cause: Annotator omitted the quantity phrase 一个 on 车队. It did include it for 货车 and 汽车.
14.convention: Numeral plus classifier on a noun is annotated as :quant and :unit, consistently for every counted noun.

14.kind: Temporal adverb 尔后 missing as :temporal
14.cause: Annotator did not annotate the sentence-initial temporal adverb and expressed the ordering only through document-level relations.
14.convention: Temporal adverbs or connectives such as 尔后 'afterwards' are annotated as a :temporal child of the main event.

14.kind: 组成-01 argument roles wrong: ARG1-of with ARG2 instead of ARG0-of with ARG1
14.cause: Annotator chose a different role frame for 组成 and mapped the fleet as the thing composed (ARG1). The gold treats the fleet as the composing whole (ARG0) and the cars as ARG1.
14.convention: Core roles must follow the PropBank frame for the sense. Check the roleset for 组成 and assign ARG0 and ARG1 as it defines them.

14.kind: Aspect of 护送-01 given as activity instead of performance
14.cause: Annotator chose the default activity aspect for 护送 and did not treat it as a bounded, completed event.
14.convention: The gold annotates 护送 as a performance.

14.kind: Possessor relation reversed: :possessor on 货车 pointing to 组织 instead of :possessor-of
14.cause: Annotator wrote 组织 as the possessor of the truck, but the gold uses :possessor-of on 货车 with 组织 as the child. The gold's direction is the unusual one.

14.kind: Document-level temporal structure differs from gold
14.cause: Annotator anchored 前往 to the document creation time and to the previous sentence, and made 组成 overlap 前往. The gold orders the previous event after 护送, makes 护送 overlap 前往 and makes 前往 overlap 运送. The annotator also left out the modifier events.

14.kind: Wrong place relation to city: :place on the 仓库 in place of 位于-01 ARG1 city; also an extra coref link
14.cause: This follows from the 位于 event being dropped, so the location was attached as :place. The annotator also introduced coreference between 辆 and 汽车 and did not link the 车队 and 仓库 chains.

14.kind: Coreference chains wrong: spurious 辆–辆 and 汽车 links, missing 车队 and 仓库 chains
14.cause: Annotator linked the 辆 and 汽车 nodes within the sentence, which do not corefer. It did not link the repeated 车队 and 仓库 mentions to earlier and later sentences.
14.convention: Coref links are for repeated mentions of the same discourse entity across sentences, not for a noun and its own classifier or within one noun phrase.

15.kind: Missing consecutive structure: 'after' clause and main clause not coordinated as a consecutive event sequence; instead 后 used as a concept with temporal relation
15.cause: Annotator treated 后 as a temporal head node with :op1 and put the main clause as root 'and', rather than using the 'consecutive' discourse concept to sequence the three event groups
15.convention: Sequences of events connected by temporal 'after/then' connectives are annotated with a 'consecutive' coordination with ordered op1, op2, op3, rather than reifying the connective as a concept and nesting the earlier clause under it

15.kind: Adverb 首先 omitted and 后 wrongly used as a concept; 首先 should be a :temporal child of 命中-01

16.kind: Wrong temporal relations for 行驶 and 命中: annotator put 行驶 :before 命中; gold has 行驶 :contained 命中 and 行驶 :before 击毁 context-wise ordering with 命中 not before 击毁

16.kind: Extra temporal relation 命中 :overlap 离 between coordinated clauses (and extra DCT/prior-sentence before links)

17.kind: 移动 destination and purpose structure: 汽车 as ARG1 instead of :goal; 继续 coordinated as op2 instead of :purpose of 移动

17.kind: attacker of 袭击 marked :instrument instead of :ARG0, and 遭到 ARG0 is the vehicle in gold (survivor in annotation)

17.kind: ordinal 第三次 lacks the classifier unit 次

17.kind: convoy relation to 工作者 annotated as :possessor-of instead of :part-of

17.kind: spurious coreference chains linking 袭击 events and 汽车/车 mentions

18.kind: Quantifier 每一辆 split into quant 每 + unit 辆 instead of a single concept 每一辆 with 几乎 as its modifier

18.kind: Locative/temporal postposition phrase 过程中 not annotated as :temporal 中 with op1 过程; the annotator produced a wrong unit 辆 and a spurious include

18.kind: Spurious include-91 for 其中 and a duplicated 命中 event with a split 车 entity

18.kind: 距离 related to 逃离 with :ARG1-of instead of :extent-of

18.kind: Aspect of 逃离-01 given as activity instead of performance

18.kind: Temporal relations anchored to 长达-01 instead of 逃离-01, with the chain 追杀 → 命中 → 命中 not matching
18.cause: Annotator made 长达 the temporal anchor and linked it to 逃离 and 命中. The gold anchors on the embedded event 逃离, since 长达 is a stative measure, and chains 逃离, 追杀, 命中 and 命中 by overlap.

18.kind: Coreference to 汽车 mentions wrongly added, and the event-level chain over 命中 (snt16, snt21, snt22) missing

19.kind: Source phrase 根据…说法 made the root have-source-91 over the whole sentence; 说法 entity and identity-91 are missing. Gold roots the sentence in contrast-91 and attaches 说法 (with have-source-91 ARG2 军队) as an identity-91 on 得到.

19.kind: 情报 称 … content clause annotated as an event 称-01 (ARG2) instead of identity-91 with the content as ARG2

19.kind: Wrong clause structure. 停留 is placed outside the reported content in a contrast-91 with 离开 under the and with 得到. 19.kind: Role label wrong on 停留 (place instead of arg1 for 仓库); 离开 ARG1 仓库 attached to the wrong structure

19.kind: Wrong sense or form of 混 (混-01 vs 混-03)

19.kind: 武装 (armed) treated as a bare entity concept; gold has event 武装-01 with aspect performance, so no sense, aspect or modal for it

19.kind: The approved-route phrase 按照事先获得以军批准的路线 is modelled wrongly. The annotator uses 批-01 with ARG0 军队 and the route as a direct manner. Gold has manner 按照-01 ARG1 路线, and the route is ARG0-of 获得-01 with ARG1 批准-01, ARG2 军队 and temporal 事先.

20.kind: Light-verb 发动 + 袭击 structure collapsed: 袭击 used as the main event, 发动-01 missing

20.kind: Place name 去冲突地带 (deconflicted zone) annotated as a zone with a name, not as a concept with identity-91 to deconflicted-zone

20.kind: Predicate 印有 wrongly shortened to 印-01, with arguments mislabeled: ARG0 vs ARG1, possessor vs possessor-of, part vs possessor-of, and the location treated as place

20.kind: Aspect missing on the event noun 袭击 nested under 发动; extra aspect node placement

20.kind: Temporal relations wrong: 指出 given :after the attack and a different overlap chain, rather than the gold chain 指出 overlap 印有 overlap 控制 overlap 发动 overlap 袭击

20.kind: Modal structure differs: the annotator links the author to the organization's source, and its full-affirmative relations hang off the wrong nodes

20.kind: Coreference differs: the annotator links the country to earlier country nodes (extra) and misses the 军队 chain; the 空袭/袭击 event chain is partial

27.kind: Event-headed coordination instead of person-headed coordination with ARG0-of

27.kind: Nominal predicate 为 modelled as identity-91; 原 dropped; wrong frame sense and role for 居

27.kind: Extra modal annotation on the include-91 / 遇难 event
